hourly.summary: Gunners are buzzing with quiet confidence — Rice Ballon d'Or chants, title race 'knapping in' on Liverpool, and dreams of poaching City's finest. The squad ladder debate shows depth, and even Vini Jr's 'career rescue' transfer banter lands with a wink. North London's dreaming of doubles and golden balls.

daily.summary: Arsenal fan sentiment surged dramatically throughout the day, rising from a buoyant morning (8/10) fueled by strong team metrics and transfer optimism, through a cautiously hopeful midday (7/10) centered on Declan Rice's contract talks amid fixture anxiety, to outright euphoria (10/10) by evening as Arsenal players starred in England's World Cup final victory. The through-line is Rice — thriving at club and country — anchoring a day that ended in peak 'Arsenal won the World Cup' delirium.

weekly.summary: The week began in euphoric triumph after a historic Anfield victory that sent Arsenal top, but sentiment quickly volatilized — swinging from confident title-race dominance to transfer-market cynicism and squad-management anxiety by mid-week. A recovery followed as rivals faltered and Arsenal extended their lead to six points, yet the prevailing mood remained edgy: fans frame every win as survival, haunted by refereeing paranoia, injury fears, and a siege mentality that refuses comfort even in success.
